youtube_title: Jesus... Why Do I Feel Like A Fraud On My First Day? | Psalms 139:14 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... I start the new job tomorrow. 😔

Tomorrow morning he starts a new job, and tonight he is certain they hired the wrong person.

He: Jesus... I start the new job tomorrow. 😔

He: Everyone congratulated me. But I keep thinking they'll find out in week one that I'm not good enough.

Jesus: You stayed up past midnight reading their docs like exam notes. Why do you think I led you there?

He: What if they ask something I can't answer and I just freeze?

Jesus: You will. Then you'll say the most senior words in any room: let me check and get back to you.

He: But everyone there looks like they belong. I look like I walked in with a fake badge.

Jesus: They all had a first day. Every one of them didn't know where the cups were either.

He: I just don't want my first impression to be the wrong one.

Jesus: It's already done. They chose you from everyone who applied. Tomorrow you walk in as the person they picked.

Jesus: Walk in slowly. I already went ahead of you and saved your seat.

"I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well."
Psalms 139:14 (BSB)

It's already done. They chose you from everyone who applied. Tomorrow you walk in as the person they picked.
